name: microduck_rl
one_liner: Training software that teaches a small two-legged robot duck how to walk, using computer simulation before it ever touches real hardware.
buyer: A robotics hobbyist or small startup building affordable legged robots who wants to test walking behavior without breaking expensive hardware.
business_use_cases: A robotics startup trains and tests new walking gaits in simulation for its small legged robot before deploying to physical units.
A university robotics lab uses it to teach students reinforcement learning with a real, buyable robot at the end of the pipeline.
A hobbyist sells a robot kit bundled with pre-trained walking behaviors as a beginner-friendly product.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a robot kit plus a guided course on training your own walking policy.
Offer custom gait-training consulting to small robotics hardware startups.

steal_this: A real niche opportunity but a small, hardware-bound market — good for a robotics educator or kit-seller, not a mass-market weekend project.
